note: Madar design tokens v3. Every room defines the same core roles (bg, surface, ink, ink2, line, accent, onAccent) for light and dark, plus room-specific semantic roles. Generate Swift (Color assets / RoomTheme) from this file; never hand-type colors. Every value in this file is final; nothing is left for a coding agent to invent. Naming rule: a base semantic color (hifz, due, reserve, amber...) is a SHAPE color (fills, strokes, large text >= 24pt or bold >= 18.5pt); text smaller than that uses the matching *Text token. The 'contrast' block is GENERATED by tools/contrast.py (WCAG 2.x, alpha composited over the real underlying background in sRGB) and lists every pair that is allowed.

license.summary: Thmanyah font licence (official page, read 2026-10-09): embedding in websites, web apps, mobile apps and software products is allowed ONLY as part of a bundled/packaged/obfuscated product; redistributing, sharing, uploading, hosting or making the font files available for download on their own is forbidden; modifying, adapting, translating or reverse-engineering the font is forbidden; commercial use is allowed; copyright notices inside the files must not be removed or altered; no authorship claim. The licence states it can be updated by the publisher.

madarUse.appBundle: allowed (fonts inside the signed .app, registered with UIAppFonts)
madarUse.exportOrTemplate: never embed the font file in exported files (PDF export uses outlined/subset text rendered by the system, no attached .ttf/.otf; share templates reference the font by name only)
madarUse.publicRepoOrHosting: forbidden: font files are not committed to a public repository and never served from a URL
madarUse.modification: forbidden: no subsetting, renaming, or merging of Thmanyah files

license.beforeFirstDistribution: keep a copy of the licence text that ships with the downloaded font package next to the files and record its SHA-256 and each font file's SHA-256 in provenance.json (fonts section); if the shipped licence differs from this summary, the shipped file wins and this entry is updated

typeScale.units: size and lineHeightPt are iOS points at the Large (default) Dynamic Type size; lineHeightMultiple is unitless (line box = size x multiple). SwiftUI: .lineSpacing(max(0, size*multiple - UIFont(...).lineHeight)); for lineHeightPt: .lineSpacing(max(0, scaledPt - UIFont.lineHeight)) where scaledPt = UIFontMetrics(forTextStyle:).scaledValue(for: lineHeightPt). Every role scales with Dynamic Type through its relativeTo text style unless scalesWithDynamicType = false.

heroNumber.rule: available = container width - 2 x cardPadding. Measure the formatted string (digits + isolates + unit) at each step from the largest; use the first step whose width <= available AND whose line height <= 40% of the card height. If 40 does not fit: minimumScaleFactor 0.7 (never below 28pt), then move the unit/currency word to its own line below in 'caption'. Never truncate a number.

examples.result: 40 then scale to >= 28, unit on its own line

fine.note: minimum text size anywhere (app and widgets); was 10.5 in v2

diaryLine.note: fixed ruled-paper pitch; RuledPaper draws its rules at the same scaled pitch so text always sits on the line

mushaf.note: fixed typesetting; legibility via zoom 1x-3x and the semantic ayah layer (see p3 §5 accessibility)

quran.note: Quran room 11-step ladder. Mushaf page text does not scale with Dynamic Type; everything else scales through AX5.

rules: · is allowed only with a space on both sides between date parts; never touching a digit without a space
primary date follows core.firstCalendar except the diary calendar (notes.calendarFirst)
wrap signed amounts in Unicode isolates U+2066..U+2069

lobbyGrid.formula: W = min(screenWidth - 2*margin, maxContentWidth); cell = (W - (columns-1)*gap) / columns; widget(w,h) = (w*cell + (w-1)*gap) x (h*cell + (h-1)*gap)
lobbyGrid.packing: dense first-fit, row by row from the right
lobbyGrid.noClip: content inside a Lobby block (in-app; not a system widget) is laid out for the smallest cell (65.5pt). An icon widget shows glyph + one 11pt label; if the label does not fit it moves to the accessibility label only. Any widget whose content would clip at the current Dynamic Type size grows one size step (small->wide, wide->large) at render time without changing the saved layout.
lobbyGrid.accessibilitySizes: at Dynamic Type AX1-AX5 the grid becomes one column of full-width widget rows (each widget's list representation), order preserved
lobbyGrid.systemWidgets: system (WidgetKit) widgets keep the family the OS chose and drop lowest-priority items (p11 §9); they never resize

motion.reference: each token names ONE curve. SwiftUI: .timingCurve(c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, duration: d). CSS references use cubic-bezier with the same four numbers. No spring is used anywhere, so the prototype and the app animate identically.

reduceMotion.fallback: no scale; haptic and state change only
no rotation; edit mode shown by the − badges and a 1pt dashed outline
word appears instantly, no blur (the reveal itself is functional and stays)

rahlFold.sequence: page turns -> book lies down -> lectern folds -> line

motion.reduceMotion: read @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion); every token above lists its fallback. Never removed: state changes, color changes, haptics.

rules: accent (#9A7536 / #D9B66C) is the SHAPE color: rings, orbit, icons, progress. Any filled control that carries text uses accentFill with onAccent (light onAccent on accent = 4.15, fails for small text; on accentFill = 5.48).
amber is the 'missed once' habit state: fill stays #C98A1E but carries a 1pt amberText outline + a dot glyph (amber alone on surface = 2.89 < 3).

status.qada: ink2 outlined star with a small «ق» + label «قضاء»

arch.shape: horseshoe: circle descends 30° below springing, then shoulders

rules: ink3 (#8A7E6E / #857866) is for rules, placeholders' icon glyphs and text >= 24pt only; smaller text uses ink3Text

hifz (#C2962A) is a shape color only (2.68 on surface): map cells in hifz state also carry a 1pt hifzText inner stroke; text uses hifzText (#775D1A light, #C1983D dark) which passes on bg, surface and on hifzTint over surface.
dark review (#2B8546) is for shapes/large text only; small text uses reviewText (#56A96F) which passes on reviewTint.
memorized in Fihris = quran.memorized (#2F6B3A / #8CC79E, approved from the final R18-Fihris file); review color #1F6E36 / #2B8546 is for review only; today's wird = hifz/gold; overdue = due
state is never color-only in the 604 map: memorized = solid fill, review = fill + center dot, due = diagonal hatch, today's wird = 1.5pt ring
